results.title: Murder, Lies and Marriage
results.overview: After mistakenly being imprisoned five long years for a murder she didn't commit, Nicole is released from prison and immediately tries to reconnect with her now twelve-year-old daughter, Sarah, who she never saw while in prison.

results.title: Violent Volition
results.overview: A conversation about free will versus determinism through the eyes of two fighting game warriors. Do they have the power of  choice, or are they puppets on a string? Can they change their destiny, or are they condemned to kill?

results.title: Bonjour Tristesse
results.overview: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. The arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend turns her world upside down.

results.title: The Red Envelope

results.overview: After a supernatural marriage binds them for life, thief-turned-informant Menn and his ghost husband Titi set out to solve the mystery of Titi's death.

results.title: Meet the Pickles: The Making of "Win or Lose"
results.original_title: Meet the Pickles: The Making of "Win or Lose"
results.overview: Discover how Pixar brought its first long-form original series to life. This behind-the-scenes documentary introduces the scrappy filmmaking team that drew from personal experiences to create this ambitious and stylistically unique series that follows a middle-school softball team, the Pickles, in the week leading up to the big championship game.

results.title: 2000 Meters to Andriivka
results.overview: Amid the failing counteroffensive, a journalist follows a Ukrainian platoon on their mission to traverse one mile of heavily fortified forest and liberate a strategic village from Russian occupation. But the farther they advance through their destroyed homeland, the more they realize that this war may never end.

results.title: The Love Scam
results.overview: Drowning in debt, two brothers concoct a plan to scam a wealthy heiress and save their home in Naples — but unexpected love soon complicates the scheme.

results.title: Berebut Jenazah
results.overview: When Naomi died, her Muslim father and Buddhist mother fought over her body, which made the burial process complicated.

results.title: Black Hole
results.overview: Max is unsatisfied with the mundanity of his town in which no person has ever left. But when Max discovers a black hole that seemingly leads to "the outside" his life is turned upside down at the imminent possibility of escape.

results.title: Hijacked
results.overview: When a group of ruthless hijackers take control of a flight and try to force their way into the cockpit, an aviation security officer must find a way to fight back while still safely protect the passengers.

results.title: The Slicks
results.overview: In the 1980s two short story writers, desperate for an idea, conjure inspiration by meddling with their neighbor's private affairs.

results.title: La principessa
results.overview: Principessa is a homeless woman who lives in a dilapidated van in a suburban parking lot. She scrapes together small amounts of money through prostitution, abuses alcohol and drugs, but remains a fragile woman with a good heart. Her sweet but precarious balance is shattered when the “Piccolo Circo” arrives at the place she loves so much: the parking ban, the arrival of the police, the seizure of her vehicle, and the awareness, albeit unclear, that she must leave that maternal womb forever.

results.title: Double Date
results.overview: A newly out middle-aged lesbian panics before a third date and impulsively hires a sex worker to help her prepare.

results.title: Animality
results.overview: Ai Weiwei examines our relationship with animals, from China and Egypt to the Danish mink farms. At times violent, always thought-provoking - and above all, a mirror image of ourselves.

results.title: Two Women
results.overview: Violette and Florence are two women with something in common, beyond being neighbours. While one finds herself on an emotional edge during her maternity leave, the other feels nothing at all, and neither can make sense of what’s happening to them. Realising that their suburban lives have left them unfulfilled, Florence begins an affair that kicks off a sexual revolution where having fun is the top priority. But between handyman hookups, chaotic misadventures, and marital strife, is reality destined to come crashing down on them?

results.title: Planet Single: Greek Adventure
results.overview: A Greek getaway for five friends turns into a hilarious detective story when suspicions rise around one of their partners — who may be a famous con-man.

results.title: The First Ride
results.overview: Four lifelong friends—Tae-jeong, Do-jin, Yeon-min, and Geum-bok—dreamed of an epic trip abroad, but life got in the way. Years later, older but not necessarily wiser, they finally embark on their long-overdue journey. Planned as a carefree getaway, however, the trip derails into a whirlwind of unexpected chaos, hilariously absurd detours, and buried emotions resurfacing. As they stumble through misadventures, their first ride together turns into a spectacular journey—one for the ages.

results.title: Cartel
results.overview: He's a well known Fraudster who runs a Cartel, but When the scores are up.the only language he understands is survival ,But Amanda will do anything possible to save her brother who's caught in the web of this syndicate.

results.title: Zamana
results.overview: In the mid-90s, the upbringing of triplets is altered with the arrival of Ana, their younger sister. Through a family trip, the director portrays this bond among sisters.

results.title: GJLS: Ibuku Ibu-Ibu
results.overview: The togetherness of 3 siblings in thwarting their father's intention to remarry leads to family disintegration and minimal inheritance distribution.
